<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I've got the list from Brad. Now I need to compare my list of Priya's and Marcus's joint availability with Brad's list for Elena and David to find a common slot.

My list (Priya & Marcus free):
*   Mon: 09:00, 09:30
*   Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
*   Wed: 15:00, 15:30
*   Thu: 10:00
*   Fri: 11:00, 11:30

Brad's list (Elena & David free):
*   Mon: 11:00, 11:30
*   Tue: 09:00, 09:30
*   Wed: 13:00, 13:30
*   Thu: 09:30, 14:30, 15:00
*   Fri: 15:00, 15:30

Let's compare the lists.
*   Monday: My list has 09:00, 09:30. Brad's has 11:00, 11:30. No overlap.
*   Tuesday: My list has 13:00, 13:30, 16:30. Brad's has 09:00, 09:30. No overlap.
*   Wednesday: My list has 15:00, 15:30. Brad's has 13:00, 13:30. No overlap.
*   Thursday: My list has 10:00. Brad's has 09:30, 14:30, 15:00. No overlap.
*   Friday: My list has 11:00, 11:30. Brad's has 15:00, 15:30. No overlap.

This is a problem. There is no time that works for all four partners. I should double check my work.

Let's re-check the common availability for Priya and Marcus.

Priya Free:
Mon: 09:00, 09:30, 13:00, 13:30
Tue: 10:30, 13:00, 13:30, 14:30, 16:30
Wed: 12:30, 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 09:00, 10:00, 13:00, 14:30
Fri: 11:00, 11:30, 13:00, 14:00

Marcus Free:
Mon: 09:00, 09:30, 11:00, 15:00
Tue: 11:00, 13:00, 13:30, 15:30, 16:30
Wed: 09:00, 12:00, 14:00, 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 10:00, 12:00
Fri: 11:00, 11:30, 14:30

Common Availability (Priya & Marcus):
Mon: 09:00, 09:30
Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
Wed: 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 10:00
Fri: 11:00, 11:30

My list is correct. Brad's list for Elena and David has no overlap with my list. It seems there is no time for the meeting to happen. I have two options: report that the meeting is infeasible, or ask Brad to double-check his work. It's possible Brad made a mistake when creating his list, just as I was worried I might have. I'll ask him to double check. It is better to be sure before we declare the meeting impossible to schedule.

I will write a message to Brad in the workspace, explaining the situation and asking him to double check his list of availabilities for Elena and David. It might be helpful to share the full availability of my two partners with Brad. That way, he can see for himself that there's no overlap.

I'll send Brad the full availability for Priya and Marcus, and ask him to do the same for Elena and David if he confirms his list is correct. This way, we can both be certain there is no common slot.It seems we're running into a wall. After comparing our lists, there are no times that work for all four partners. I've double-checked the schedules for Priya and Marcus, and my list of their availability is correct.

Could you please double-check the calendars for Elena and David? It's possible there was an error when you compiled your list. If you confirm your list is correct, then there are no available times for this meeting, and we'll have to report that.
